question:
Select the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word in the given sentence.

I have a __vague__ memory of meeting her many years ago.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Hazy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"vague"** means something that is unclear, indistinct, or not sharply defined. (अस्पष्ट)

 
 
• **Example:** His explanation was so vague that it left everyone confused.
 
 
 
• **"Hazy"** refers to something that is cloudy, unclear, or lacking clarity, often used to describe memories or visibility. (धुंधला)
 
 
• **Example:** I have a hazy recollection of the events that happened last night.
 
 
 
• Hence, we can infer that the synonym for **'vague' **is **'hazy'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Hazy**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Evident** (स्पष्ट): Something that is clearly understood or obvious.

 
 
• **Example:** It is evident that she worked hard for her success.
 
 
 
• **Pellucid** (पारदर्शी): Extremely clear or transparent.
 
 
• **Example:** The pellucid waters of the lake reflected the clear blue sky.
 
 
 
• **Symbolic** (प्रतीकात्मक): Representing something else, often in an abstract or metaphorical manner.
 
 
• **Example:** The dove is symbolic of peace and harmony.
